content: Bamangka kuli-bakangka janangan kanbinka Godumu bayan ngaranka baja.

Kanbal bama bubumun yindu-yindumun bubungu Judah bundandarin, jana Israel-warranka wawu kari. Jana Israel-warranda dungarin, jurril balkan, yalaman, “Nganjin yurranga God yalarrku buyay-manil. Nganjin yurranda mara dajinka, Godumu bayan ngaranka baja.” Yamba Israel-warrangka yalaman, “Kari, nganjin yurrawunku helpmunku wawu kari. Kingangka nganjininku yungan, ngaranka, yurranin kari.” Yinyamun jana bama bubungu Judah bundandarin, jana jananin Israel-warra kirinka, Godumu bayan ngaranka baja.
